title: What If Half Your Brain Were Removed? Some People Live It

scenes.text: What if half your brain were removed? Some people live that way.
Surgeons do it in severe childhood epilepsy, taking out an entire hemisphere.
In a Johns Hopkins study of 58 patients, 29 of the 54 survivors became seizure-free.
Language can move to the remaining half in children up to about age thirteen.
Caltech scientists scanned six adults who had it as children. Their brain activity looked like whole brains.
The surviving half had stronger links between its networks than normal, as if one side learned to do the work of two.

description:
What if half your brain were removed?
For some children with severe epilepsy it happens, and the remaining half can take over.
